items.title: Contain every manifest-controlled layer path before inspection or mutation.
acceptance: reject traversal and absolute manifest paths
reject paths that resolve to the workspace root
reject symlinks whose canonical target escapes the workspace
accept valid existing and not-yet-existing nested paths
apply one resolver before update, upgrade, remove, inspection, hashing, diff, graph, map, and agent instantiation
prove that force cannot bypass containment
pass package, CLI, packed-artifact, and real Rail integration checks
evidence: test/managed-path.test.js: traversal, absolute, root, missing nested, and symlink containment cases pass
test/cli.test.js: Rail initialization, repair, and invalid-state verification cases pass
npm.cmd run check: self-check passed with 117 assertions on 2026-07-23
npm.cmd run pack:verify: packed artifact self-check passed with 117 assertions on 2026-07-23

extensions.acceptance_result: All acceptance checks passed; the release stop line is cleared.

items.title: Roll back failed initialization to a clean retryable target
acceptance: failed init removes only paths created by that invocation
a newly created target is removed when rollback leaves it empty
a pre-existing empty target remains present and empty
retry succeeds after the external source failure is repaired
the original error remains visible when cleanup also fails
Windows, POSIX, packed-artifact, spaces, non-ASCII, and read-only cleanup fixtures pass
evidence: architectonic/architectonic#6 defines the rollback and retry contract
architectonic/architectonic#7 contains the bounded implementation and deterministic failed-source/retry tests
exact-head npm test, check, pack:verify, Windows/POSIX, cleanup-failure, and independent review remain required
items.stop_line: Do not merge until exact-head package, packed-artifact, cross-platform, cleanup-failure, and path-preservation checks pass.

items.title: Separate read-only integrity verification from explicit package adoption
acceptance: doctor and verify cannot clear package integrity, package-name, protocol, source, or revision drift by rewriting the manifest from the current tree
safe repair is limited to independently derivable organization-owned or manifest metadata
local contract changes require an explicit dry-run adoption or re-pin plan
Git and npm adoption prove exact source provenance and hashes
synthetic tampering remains visible after every ordinary repair command
help and documentation distinguish inspect, repair, update, upgrade, and adoption
items.stop_line: No integrity claim while doctor or verify can redefine the recorded trust baseline from unverified current contents.

items.title: Lock the public Architectonic package family to one compatible verifiable baseline
acceptance: one machine-readable family manifest names the exact CLI, protocol, package versions, source commits, integrity hashes, dependencies, schemas, runtime requirements, and rollback boundary
clean Git and registry-equivalent npm installations pass for standalone layers, named profiles, and representative custom compositions
update and upgrade from the prior supported family report exact preserve, replace, conflict, and unsupported downgrade behavior
package metadata, README examples, CLI defaults, generated Rail and agent or skill bindings agree with the family manifest
ABKB adopts and verifies the public family without leaking private instance state
no stable-family claim or publication occurs from dirty, unreviewed, or unverified artifacts
items.stop_line: Do not add another public layer or call Architectonic stable until one exact family passes packed, source, upgrade, rollback, and ABKB adoption checks.

items.title: Define the minimal public system-of-systems CLI contract without absorbing Workframe
acceptance: Architectonic owns package inspection, composition, validation, dry-run planning, exact plan application, upgrade, removal, and portable agent or skill or Rail templates
Workframe owns conversational discovery, provider and runtime consent, collaboration, deployment, and product-specific onboarding
Workframe calls a versioned noninteractive Architectonic JSON contract rather than private imports or duplicate composition logic
plans name target and source hashes, every file action, ownership, authority, conflicts, migration, rollback, and one immutable plan hash
apply fails when target or source facts differ from the reviewed plan
existing non-Architectonic systems and user-owned files remain outside managed authority
help, README, tests, and caller examples state one responsibility boundary
items.stop_line: Do not merge the Workframe and Architectonic CLIs or build a generalized autonomous-organization runtime in this item.

items.title: Make npm layer upgrade backups ownership-safe and crash-recoverable
acceptance: upgrade never removes a pre-existing backup path without a durable Architectonic ownership record and explicit cleanup decision
one contained transaction record binds old and staged versions, hashes, paths, phase, and manifest state before rename
process-kill fixtures at every rename and manifest boundary recover deterministically to old or new state
retry, resume, rollback, and stale transaction behavior are explicit
Windows locked-file, disk-full, backup collision, spaces, non-ASCII, and manifest-write failure fixtures pass
local modifications remain a review gate and the old layer remains until the new layer and manifest are durably committed
items.stop_line: No upgrade path may recursively delete an adjacent path merely because its name matches an internal convention.
